notes: All six pages read from the Common Crawl captures listed in chunk-64.json (seven text files; no live copies were listed for this chunk). Rutgers Business School alumni page (both captures): the page says it lists 'all the graduates from the last five years with their initial placement'; the table column is only headed 'Year', so yearMeaning 'graduation' follows the page's 'graduates' wording, but the 2019 capture lists 2019 rows whose placement reads 'On the job market', so the year may be the job-market/degree year rather than a conferred-degree year; integrators should treat it with care. Program is the major heading of the section (Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Management Science, Operations Research, etc.); destination is the Placement column as written (set to null with a note when it reads 'On the job market' or 'Unknown at this time'). 'Alex Abakah' appears twice in both captures (Finance 2017, St. John Fisher College; Operations Research 2017, Royal Bank of Canada) exactly as printed; likely a page error worth checking. The 2019 capture adds 2019 graduates and some extra 2018 names (e.g. Ahmad AlQassar, Ussama Yaqub, Andres Velez Calle, Salma Zaman, Sevincgul Ulu, Serdar Yayla, Irene Akaab, Myles Garvey) and changes two placements (Nilofar Varzgani: A.T. Kearney -> La Salle University; Onome Ighoavodha: Missouri Southern State University -> Nicholls State University). RUTCOR alumni page: the first list (87 entries) carries dissertation titles, adviser and a month-year, and is separate from a 'Masters Degrees' section; the page never prints the word 'PhD' for the first list, so degree is left null, but these are the doctoral alumni. The month-year is recorded as the graduation year (it is the degree/dissertation date beside the adviser). 'Current affiliation' is recorded in note only, not as destination, because it is a current affiliation as of the page, not a placement. Email addresses printed on the page were deliberately omitted. Entries 80-87 (David Neu through Tsvetan Asamov) are surrounded by stray '>' and '-->' comment markers in the capture, so they may have been hidden by HTML comments on the rendered page; recorded as data but flagged. Master's graduates and the two Master of Philosophy entries in the Masters section were skipped. UNC Kenan-Flagler page: only a 'Job Market Candidates' name list with areas and no year; 'Recent Placements' is a list of institutions without names and yields no records. listedYear is null. ASU Management & Entrepreneurship alumni page: page says it lists all department PhD graduates with current affiliation, year of graduation and dissertation title; four entries (Daniel Newton, Jisun Kim, Melissa Chamberlin, Beth Schinoff) have no dissertation or year and are recorded with listedYear null.
